# Active work — evidence-intake-project

Live work, grouped by parent in `ROADMAP.md` order. Blocked work names its blocker inline.

## [Case assembly: the missing middle between extraction and digest](ROADMAP.md#case-assembly-the-missing-middle-between-extraction-and-digest) `@evidence-intake-project.assembly.case-assembly/1`

### Keyboard-driven enrichment workspace with a measured keystroke budget

`active` · `@evidence-intake-project.assembly.enrichment-workspace/1` · part of `@evidence-intake-project.assembly.case-assembly/1`

The throughput design: a grid-first WinSafe view with the original always rendered beside it; decide once per source in a profile and inherit everywhere; sweep one field across passages with single-key values, Enter to accept a candidate, x to reject it, '.' to repeat, Shift-letter and visual ranges to apply to a run, s to split a sub-span, g to group rows, p to set the reporting parent to the nearest preceding same-author passage, @ entity autocomplete with create-new and possibly-same-person, t for time entry with a sticky basis, n for boilerplate, u to supersede. Every keystroke that changes a value writes one interpretation row under the named actor. Workspace navigation moves to Ctrl-digit accelerators because the Alt namespace is full, and the accelerator-uniqueness test is extended. Just-in-time prompts use the same grammar when a passage is attached to a proposition. A scripted harness in tests/enrichment.rs drives the Workspace API and ratchets the budget: at most 1.6 keystrokes per material passage for form, speaker and stance; at most 4 per reported statement for parent and attributed person. Plan sections 5.1-5.7.

### Deterministic cue rules that propose interpretations and provenance edges

`proposed` · `@evidence-intake-project.assembly.candidate-rules/1` · part of `@evidence-intake-project.assembly.case-assembly/1`

Versioned analyzers in the existing suggest:<rule>@<version> contract, no model, no score, no tolerance, never touching a human-written row or re-proposing a rejected one: inherit-profile, reported-statement (stated that / advised / told), quoted-statement (balanced quotes, sub-span), measured-result (number plus unit), official-characterization (statute shapes), evidence-reference (BWC, exhibit, recording, plus a refers_to edge when a case source matches by name), asserted-clock, header-date, diarization-speaker, cross-document-echo (a shared exact token run between a later document and an earlier transcript proposes summarizes or quotes), and shared-anchor (turns today's date-plus-location grouping into a candidate_same_occurrence proposal). Each rule ships with a true positive, a true negative and its most likely adversarial miss. Plan section 5.4.

### Deterministic, template-rendered, source-linked layered digest

`proposed` · `@evidence-intake-project.assembly.deterministic-digest/1` · part of `@evidence-intake-project.assembly.case-assembly/1`

Store::case_digest renders nine layered sections (posture and elements; recorded sequence in separate lanes where unaligned; contemporaneous accounts; later accounts; official narrative; proposition packets; dependencies and conflicts; missing and unreviewed; privileged issues for the work-file audience only, structurally excluded from the disclosable one as export_case already does). Every factual sentence comes from a typed Template; a template whose slots cannot all be filled from reviewed records is not emitted and the header counts the omission. validate_digest fails with Error::UnsupportedSentence on any sentence without a locator and the CLI and GUI refuse to save it. record_brief refuses a factual brief_paragraphs row with no references. No language model participates; a later compressor may only reorder or shorten emitted sentences with ids and locators intact and the validator run on its output. Plan section 8.

### Descriptive provenance edges, lineage, and occurrence assembly

`proposed` · `@evidence-intake-project.assembly.edge-vocabulary-and-lineage/1` · part of `@evidence-intake-project.assembly.case-assembly/1`

Migration 0012 rebuilds edges (the CHECK on a STRICT table cannot be altered) with the descriptive relations quotes, reports, summarizes, transcribes, depicts, records_utterance, measures, based_on, account_of, created_after, recorded_during, candidate_same_occurrence, speaker_candidate and the evaluative consistent_with and independently_corroborates; corroborates is retired and rewritten to consistent_with; the unique-claim index is recreated and asserted. Adapters may propose the descriptive set; the evaluative set stays human-only. Store::lineage walks reviewed descriptive edges to roots; every count becomes 'N original files, M reporting lineages, K without a reviewed dependency'; link_evidence refuses independently_corroborates between nodes sharing a lineage and names the shared root. Occurrences are reviewed candidate_same_occurrence and account_of edges onto events in a lane, never a new node table and never automatic. An Assembly view renders chains with the same accept/reject keys. The soundtrack PTS-offset question must be resolved before any view puts soundtrack utterances and visual intervals on one axis. Plan sections 3.4-3.6, 6.

### Append-only semantic interpretation layer over immutable content

`proposed` · `@evidence-intake-project.assembly.interpretation-schema/1` · part of `@evidence-intake-project.assembly.case-assembly/1`

Migration 0011 (bump SCHEMA_VERSION): content_interpretations (form, perception basis, temporal stance, speaker, attributed person, reporting parent, created/asserted/normalized times with a required alignment basis, location, materiality, per-field provenance, review state, named author, supersedes), source_profiles (source role, author, creation claim, inheritable defaults, clock offset with basis), content_groups for reviewer-defined units, and brief_paragraphs with typed references. New enums ContentForm, PerceptionBasis, TemporalStance, SourceRole in model.rs with as_str and CHECK mirrors. content.kind is not widened and content is not rebuilt. Store writers plus InterpretationBatch, the human counterpart to NormalizedBatch, imported atomically and refusing suggest: authors. Resolve the append-to-identical-source question: import_normalized accepts a batch whose source matches on id, production, sha256 and byte_length exactly when every segment and content id is new, never touching the source row. Plan sections 3.1-3.3, 5.8, 5.9.

### Stop the current views from overstating collation

`proposed` · `@evidence-intake-project.assembly.p0-honest-views/1` · part of `@evidence-intake-project.assembly.case-assembly/1`

No schema change. Rename Collation Groups to Time & Place Index and Run Collation to Find Tensions and Gaps (keeping the existing Alt letters; the window has 25 of 26 claimed); rename possibly_related to shared_anchor_unconfirmed with the non-conclusive header; replace the first-available time in write_collation_entry with a TimeLabels renderer that prints every present time under its own label and 'Alignment: not set'; add a fixed provenance badge to every rendered passage; make the audio adapter emit Observation + asr-no-speech instead of RecordingGap for unaligned intervals and a per-utterance speaker candidate edge to a placeholder 'Speaker N' entity; rename distinct_sources to distinct_originals and label it 'original files' everywhere. Plan section 4.

### Proposition packets as the primary defender workspace

`proposed` · `@evidence-intake-project.assembly.proposition-packets/1` · part of `@evidence-intake-project.assembly.case-assembly/1`

PropositionPacket read model and Store::proposition_packet: neutral text and contested status; directly captured material (contemporaneous_capture, reviewed or verified); contemporaneous accounts; later first-person accounts with both times labelled; official assertions; reporting and derivation chains as lineage groups; evaluative relations with rationale and review state; raw temporal and location conflicts, unresolved; missing and unreviewed material including expected_but_missing, unresolved speaker candidates and unset alignment; an exact locator on every item; the three-way count on every section. Attaching a passage from search or the index is one command plus the just-in-time enrichment prompt, written unreviewed with a required rationale. The no-scoring serialization test is extended to packets, and a test asserts the fixture's impairment packet derives its 'no reviewed source directly records the 21:07 condition' section from the graph. Plan section 7.

### Synthetic raw-file fixtures and adversarial end-to-end tests

`proposed` · `@evidence-intake-project.assembly.raw-file-fixtures/1` · part of `@evidence-intake-project.assembly.case-assembly/1`

A fixture family of small synthetic originals (PDFs with text layers and scanned-style pages, scripted WAVs, short MP4s) standing in for a police report, witness statement, CAD log, 911 audio, body-camera and surveillance video, later interview, lab report, and a document referring to a missing recording. One scenario and one test per adversarial case: report paraphrases the 911 call; report summarizes bodycam; ASR creates a false contradiction; no speech detected despite audible speech; event outside the field of view; two unrelated incidents share date and location; a supplemental report changes an account; bodycam and dispatch clocks disagree; a witness gives two accounts; a report references video never produced; retrospective interview beside contemporaneous 911. The hit-and-run packets and digest must be reachable from these files through the real adapters, an InterpretationBatch and the authoring API with no SQL seeding. Starts alongside the P0 work and grows with every later item. Plan section 9.

### Render the original inside the sweep, and ask for a missing field where it is needed

`proposed` · `@evidence-intake-project.assembly.sweep-remaining-surfaces/1` · part of `@evidence-intake-project.assembly.case-assembly/1`

The two parts of the enrichment sweep that are named rather than shown. First, draw the original beside the grid instead of describing it: the rendered page with the region box, the waveform with the interval, the frame strip around the selected segment. The preview descriptor already carries the retained paths; what is missing is the painting, and the crate forbids unsafe, so a GDI path through raw buffers is not available and the drawing has to go through what WinSafe exposes safely. Until then the panel names the locator, the page or interval, and whether the file still matches its intake hash, and hands the file to the system viewer. Second, plan section 5.7: when a passage is attached to a proposition in the packet workspace, ask for the field that packet needs in a three-line prompt using the same single-key grammar, so the long tail is classified where somebody actually needs it rather than swept in full. This waits on the packet workspace being built as a surface.

### Choose the visual finder model by local body-camera retrieval recall

`proposed` · `@evidence-intake-project.video.real-embedding-benchmark/1`

Implement the existing embed-cli contract with a fully local text-image encoder and compare real models on human-labeled original-timeline intervals from representative body-camera footage. Measure the sampler's opportunity to see each interval separately from the encoder's ability to retrieve it. Select and pin one exact model revision, preprocessing contract, embedding dimension and local runtime only after measuring interval recall, later-timeline coverage, indexing throughput, query latency and GPU memory on this workstation. Product hits remain unscored suggestions pointing to the original.
